description: After the Brackney email thread was resolved, no agent was spawned to file the Spring Line Advisory materials into the appropriate IES location (meetings/, contacts/, or equivalent). Master handled the email draft directly and skipped the post-execution Agent Output Handling step that requires spawning the appropriate specialist to file outputs.
correction: After any client or prospect interaction is resolved, spawn the appropriate agent (Chase for sales/prospect filing, or Sterling for contact/relationship filing) to move artifacts into their canonical IES locations.
systemic_fix: Add post-email-draft step to Master protocol: after any client email thread closes, spawn filing agent to capture contact, context, and any artifacts into IES.
